extraction.Name: Charles Miller
extraction.Refused/Protested: I told Mr. Brtton the farmer at that time that I did not want it. Some one then sent it to the Bank at Herrick where my father got it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I was to get $8500 but when I closed the deal $130 was held out for taxes. I got the rest in cash.
extraction.NOTES: Patent was brought home to him in 1918 by his father; did not sign a receipt for the patent; did not ask for the patent; has two children; was satisfied with the sale; notary public Jas. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32; affidavit sworn April 30, 1929
